q: Speaker reprimanded outsider for breach, Courts and House clashed on who decides privilege scope. Landmark?
expl: Keshav Singh 1965 advisory settled privilege vs judicial review balance.
why: Keshav Singh is core on House privilege and court interface. Others deal with property, gender, environment.

q: Ruling that Speaker certification of Money Bill is not wholly immune if tainted by gross illegality. Trend?
options: Limited review of certification for illegality
expl: Courts allow narrow check for constitutional illegality, not policy.
why: Certification respects LS supremacy. Review intervenes only on jurisdictional error, not merits.

q: Rooms doctrine that basic structure bars Parliament from destroying Constitution identity. Relevance to legislatures?
options: Limits amendment power; needs special majority each House
expl: Kesavananda limits amendment; joint sitting barred for amendments.
why: Amendment needs separate special majorities. Joint sitting cannot cure lack of numbers.

q: AP Council abolished and revived in history; current status often asked. Correct?
options: AP bicameral with Council functioning alongside Assembly
expl: AP has Council as second chamber; abolition-revival history, now bicameral.
why: AP journey shows 169 route in action. Present exam fact is bicameral continuity.

q: AP Assembly size and Council role in Money matters. Correct?
options: Assembly supreme; Council only 14-day delay on Money
expl: Assembly prevails on Money; Council recommendatory like RS.
why: Finance supremacy of popular House applies in states. Delay cannot become veto.

q: Secretary receives ordinary Bill passed by LS, RS rejects. Next institutional step?
options: President may summon joint sitting to resolve deadlock
Speaker certifies as Money to bypass
expl: 108 joint sitting for ordinary deadlock on President summons.
why: Joint sitting breaks bicameral deadlock by majority present. Money route cannot be faked.

q: Estimates scrutiny vs PAC audit: who sits where?
options: Estimates 30 LS only; PAC 22 mixed opposition chair
expl: Estimates 30 all LS; PAC 15 LS 7 RS opposition chair convention.
why: Mandates differ: estimates pre-spend, PAC post-spend audit. Membership reflects purpose.

q: Trap: Claim Money and Constitution amendment both go to joint sitting if Houses disagree. Flaw?
options: Both excluded; ordinary only goes to joint sitting
expl: Money plus Constitution excluded from 108 joint sitting.
why: Claim transplants ordinary tool to special routes. Each special route has own majority logic.

q: Trap: Claim RS can kill Money by withholding 30 days. Correct?
options: False; deemed passed after 14 days in LS form
expl: After 14 days Money deemed passed as LS passed.
why: Timeout protects finance. Withholding beyond period has no veto effect.

q: Synthesis: Link 550 cap plus women quota condition plus Council route. What holds?
options: LS cap 550, women quota after census-delimitation, Council via Assembly plus Parliament
Quota in force now, cap 700, Council by CM order
Cap abolished, quota unconditional, Council by court
expl: Combines settled caps with pending quota and two-step Council law.
why: Synthesis needs pending vs settled care. Quota conditional, caps settled, Council federal process.
